title: chore(gateway): remove unused cache_media_bytes from media_cache
claim: gateway.platforms.media_cache.cache_media_bytes has no production callers and can be removed with its tests (rebuild of fork #114).

evidence.source: Zero callers is TRUE on main: production imports only ext_for_mime/mime_for_ext from media_cache (bluebubbles, qqbot/adapter, signal, whatsapp_cloud). Do not confuse it with the unrelated, live gateway.platforms.base.cache_media_bytes(data, *, filename, mime_type) at base.py:1529. But open external PRs are actively building on this exact helper: #125651 edits its image branch, and #117403 adds a new caller. It was introduced by teknium1's #74210 ('shared media-cache mime dispatch for adapter downloads') as the shared dispatch adapters are meant to adopt.
evidence.references_before: gateway/platforms/media_cache.py:69 (def; uuid import used only here), tests/gateway/test_media_cache.py:12, :38-58

upstream_overlap: #125651 dasgltd OPEN 2026-09-29 'keep the inbound filename on cached images': modifies media_cache.cache_media_bytes (filename=filename_hint passthrough)
#117403 ArthurDentsTowel OPEN 2026-09-21 SMS inbound MMS: `from gateway.platforms.media_cache import cache_media_bytes` + asyncio.to_thread(cache_media_bytes, data, mime)
notes: Do not rebuild or promote. Deleting it would break two open external contributions. Also retire the older fork leaf #114. The fork's 915-file comparison was never used.
